Programs

All the ways to play.

Ensembles, group classes, private lessons, clinics, and jam sessions. Wherever you are in your playing, there's a place for you.

Now enrolling

Play in a real band.

Our ensembles are regular bands that meet twice a month, coached by a Twin Cities jazz musician and matched by level, instrument, and goals.

Find your band →

Group Classes — Instrumental

August cohort full

Open Spaces Ensemble

A six-session ensemble course with Chris Bates exploring sound through games, concepts, and real-time composition — for players ready to break out of chord-scale thinking. Capped at 10.

Learn more →

August cohort full

Foundations of Jazz

A group class in jazz improvisation — chord changes, phrasing, and ensemble feel, for instrumentalists newer to jazz or returning to it. Taught by Joe Hartnett and Chris Bates.

Learn more →

Not currently enrolling

Jazz Guitar Foundations

An intensive group class for intermediate guitarists ready to deepen their craft — comping, harmony, time feel, and improvisation, with Chris Graham.

Enroll →

Cohort full

Improv Lab

A focused group class on improvisation, for players ready to build their improvisational vocabulary and ear.

Learn more →

Group Classes — Vocal

August cohort full

The Jazz Singer's Playground

A welcoming class for singers exploring jazz repertoire, phrasing, and ensemble singing, with Tommy Boynton.

Enroll →

Currently on waitlist

Jazz Voice Lab

A deeper-dive lab for experienced singers focused on jazz craft, improvisation, and personal expression, with Anya Menk.

Join the waitlist →

Other ways to play

One-on-one

Private Lessons

One-on-one work with some of the best jazz musicians in the Twin Cities — alongside ensemble work or on their own, at your own pace. Available year-round.

Learn more →

Drop-in · All levels

Jam Sessions

Second Sunday Jams at Dual Citizen Brewing, plus other open sessions around town. Supportive, all levels welcome — a great way to meet other players.

See schedule →

Workshops

Clinics & Masterclasses

One-off workshops and masterclasses with visiting and local artists — focused deep-dives on a topic, instrument, or approach. Watch this space for upcoming dates.
